services.desc: The Chicago Botanic Garden has 385 acres of nature, beauty, and respite to discover. Dare to walk an eerily enchanting path aglow with artist-carved pumpkins. Among them, 75 giants tip the scales at 150 pounds each. Watch live carving in action, meet costumed performers, and enjoy playful frights around every corner. Stop for seasonal treats and drinks like homemade caramel apples, spiced nuts, apple cider donuts, spirited cocktails, and more. services.desc: The Chicago Botanic Garden has 385 acres of nature, beauty, and respite to discover. Your students are sure to have a wonderful time investigating a rich variety of plants and nature in our field trips. Bring your class to the Garden for an experience you lead or for a workshop taught by our staff. Or, choose a virtual experience from your own classroom. All workshops are phenomenon-based and correlated with the Next Generation Science Standards. services.desc: The Chicago Botanic Garden has 385 acres of nature, beauty, and respite to discover. Indoors or out, the Garden will bring your event to life. Naturally. From heirloom roses to a wisteria-covered English Walled Garden to warm natural light, surround yourself with thousands of planted blooms and fresh greenery that will live long past your special event. Your options are all undeniably breathtaking. This dramatic canopied terrace is a breathtaking setting for a summer party, dance, meeting, or reception. services.desc: The Chicago Botanic Garden has 385 acres of nature, beauty, and respite to discover. Engage your senses, discover hidden talents, and explore a more personal relationship with plants and the environment. Adult education programs at the Regenstein School in Glencoe, Illinois include art classes and garden design workshops for pure enjoyment, certificate programs, and professional development classes. Discover classes and workshops in botanical arts, horticulture, gardening, cooking, nature and birding, photography, garden design, and professional programs. blurb: Bold planting ideas are front and center in the Crescent's annual beds, while hundreds of evergreen boxwood give shape to their curves. The evergreens create a mass of green "steps" flanking the eight concentric tiers, which increase in size as they slope gently down to the water's edge.
